name: Mang cau Ba Den
summary: Custard apple from the slopes of Núi Bà Đen: a large, fragrant fruit with thick eyes, deep grooves, and chewy flesh. The mountain board calls it deeply sweet, and the tourism information center calls it lightly sweet.
origin: Núi Bà Đen and the land nearby. Tây Ninh has the country’s largest planting, 5,000 ha, and the fruit is sold year-round.
history: Cục Sở hữu trí tuệ protected the name on 10 August 2011 under Decision 1804/QĐ-SHTT. The mountain board gives the certificate as 00027, and the office’s own list gives 6-00027.
The mountain board says the fruit was rated OCOP 4 stars in 2021.
texture: Large, with thick eyes, deep grooves, and chewy flesh.
taste: Fragrant and sweet. The mountain board calls the flesh deeply sweet; the tourism information center calls it lightly sweet and fragrant.
howToEat: Eat the fruit fresh, or carry processed mãng cầu home from the mountain.
Growers mostly bag the fruit on the tree instead of spraying it.
where: The orchards on and around Núi Bà Đen.
seoTitle: Mang cau Ba Den — custard apple
seoDescription: Bà Đen custard apple, large and fragrant with chewy flesh, from the country’s largest planting.
